findings.evidence: The declarations at lines 96, 108, 122, and 160 require only general semiring/algebra or matrix-equivalence assumptions, while `TauCeti/Algebra/Subalgebra/Center.lean` already houses generic `Algebra.IsCentral` center APIs.
findings.fix: Move the matrix-centrality lemmas to a general `TauCeti/Algebra/Central/Matrix.lean`, the center/surjectivity criterion to `TauCeti/Algebra/Subalgebra/Center.lean`, and the generic matrix-finrank transport lemma to an appropriate general matrix/dimension module; import those from this file.
findings.issue: `isCentral_of_isCentral_matrix`, `isCentral_matrix_iff` (lines 96–110), `finrank_eq_sq_mul_finrank` (line 122), and `isCentral_iff_surjective_algebraMap` (line 160) have no central-simple or Wedderburn hypotheses and expose broadly reusable APIs from a later roadmap module.

summary: Three generic public lemmas are misplaced in the roadmap-specific Wedderburn module; the Wedderburn and finite-field results themselves are naturally placed and their imports are justified.
